caption: The drawing depicts a transparent glass object positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The object has a rounded base that widens outwards and supports a vertical stem, which in turn holds a bowl-shaped container. The container has a lid with a pointed top, through which a dark, twisted wick protrudes and also curves within the glass vessel. The glass is depicted with highlights and reflections in shades of white, gray, and light brown, emphasizing its transparency and reflective qualities. The drawing uses delicate lines and subtle shading to render the contours and thickness of the glass. There is a small scale and the name "John Dana" appears in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Spark Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
